risks.risk: Exact model unknown; larger or networked models are worth more, smaller ones less.
risks.proof: Clear close photo of the model name under the Sharp logo or the rating plate on the back.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest Sharp desktop copier in the class

risks.risk: Very high copy count from heavy use.
risks.proof: Photo of the counter screen or a printed counter report showing total copies.
risks.if_unproven: as high count, near end of life

risks.risk: Toner empty or missing, or the drum needs replacing.
risks.proof: Photo of the open front cover with the toner and drum in place.
risks.if_unproven: as without usable toner or drum

proof_requests: Clip of the copier making a copy from the document feeder, copy shown to the camera.

response.reason: The photo shows a Sharp desktop photocopier with document feeder, so it can be priced at its worst case as a not working unit at the low end of the class; the model, a copy sample and a counter reading would raise it.
